gloss: for commercial use, for business use

definitions.gloss: for commercial use, for business use
definitions.explanation: Intended or designed for use in a business, commercial, or professional setting rather than for personal or household use. Often refers to products sold in large quantities or with commercial-grade quality.

examples.japanese: {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}した→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧。
examples.english: We installed a commercial-grade air conditioner.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{業務用|ぎょうむよう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: This refrigerator is commercial-grade, so it's large.

examples.japanese: {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At a wholesale supermarket, you can buy ingredients in bulk at low prices.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧ (business operations) and ⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧ (for use). Contrasts with ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧ (for home use). {業務用|ぎょうむよう} products are typically larger, more durable, or sold in greater quantities than consumer versions. {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧ (wholesale supermarket) is popular even among general consumers for bulk shopping.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧: wholesale supermarket
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦{冷蔵庫|れいぞうこ}→冷蔵庫：01046_reizouko⟧: commercial refrigerator
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧: commercial food ingredients
- ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}→家庭用：16544_kateiyou⟧: for home use (contrast)
